title: The Navier-Stokes equations in $\mathbb R^2_+$ with point vortex initial data: construction of the solution
summary: This is the first of two papers concerning the asymptotic behavior of the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations in a half-space at high Reynolds numbers, with initial data given by a point vortex. In the present work, we establish the existence and uniqueness of solutions subject to the non-slip boundary condition. This result was established in \cite{Ken} under the condition that the total mass is sufficiently small.
